paite: TOUPA aw, vai hon hawmsak in, lungsim hoihtak pu in ka om a, ginglah lou in ka muang hi.
heading: David La / Mihoih Thumna
english: By David. Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon pheklek in hon enchian in; ka lungsim leh ka lungtang hihsiangthou in.
english: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

paite: Na zahngaihna ka ma ah a-om ngal a, na thutak ah ka om zel hi.
english: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

paite: Mi bangmah lou phette kiang ah ka tu ngei kei a; milepchiahte kiang ah leng ka lut sam kei ding hi.
english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte kikhawmte ka mudah a, migilou-saloute kiang ah ka tu kei ding.
english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

paite: Ka khutte gensiatbeina in ka sil ding a, huchibang in, TOUPA aw, na maitam ka vel ding hi.
english: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,

paite: Kipahthu genna ngaihtak a ka gen theih a, na thillamdang hih tengteng thute ka hilhtheihna ding in.
english: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

paite: TOUPA, na omna inn ka it a, na thupina omna leng.
english: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

paite: Ka hinna mikhialte lak ah lakhawm ke'nla, ka hinna leng sisan suah hatte lak ah lakhawm sam ke'n.
english: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

paite: Akhut uah ngaihtuah gilou a-om a, akhut taklam uh golhna in adim hi.
english: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

paite: Himahleh kei zaw lungsim hoih pu in ka om ding; hon tan inla, hon hehpih in.
english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

paite: Ka khe mun tamtak ah adingh a; kikhopkhawmna ah TOUPA aphat ding hi.
english: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.
